entities.name: Query Ham1p-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 209-aa protein containing a Ham1p-like domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 10–199.
Shows 49.7–53.9% identity and 89.5–94.7% query coverage to reviewed dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Catalytic assignment is supported by homology; exact substrate preference remains inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: EC 3.6.1.66; Mg2+-dependent nucleotide pyrophosphatase of the Ham1p-like family.
Hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates, especially XTP, dITP, and ITP, to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate.
Functions as a nucleotide-pool sanitizing enzyme that limits incorporation of damaged or noncanonical purines into nucleic acids.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.
Candidate reaction for the query protein based on close reviewed homologs.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis

Candidate reaction for the query protein based on close reviewed homologs.
